community: Remote & backcountry, Regional District of Fraser-Fort George

description.value: A mountain lake resort right off Hwy 16 about 60 km east of Prince George, offering lakefront and dry sites with sandy beach, lake swimming, boat launch, and legendary sunsets; reservation-only (no drop-ins), no public wifi, and limited cell service.

address.value: P.O. Box 1239, Prince George, BC V2L 4V3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed facility information for Purden Lake Resort. Coin-op hot showers and coin-op laundry are explicitly listed under RV Park Facilities on the camping page, and the camping page states 'All sites are by RESERVATION ONLY. (No drop-ins, No day-use).' The contact page confirms the phone number 250.565.7777 and explicitly notes no public wifi, limited cell service, and no grid power (diesel generators only).
concerns: Strictly reservations-only with no drop-ins or day-use; spontaneous stops by touring cyclists are not possible.
OSM address field is blank; only a P.O. Box mailing address in Prince George is available from the website — physical location inferred from OSM coordinates.
No public wifi and explicitly limited cell service on-site; advance planning essential for cyclists relying on connectivity.
Resort is entirely off-grid (diesel generators); e-bike charging feasibility is unknown and cannot be confirmed from available content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate seasonal campground on a major Hwy 16 cycling corridor with confirmed showers, laundry, and a dry/tent site option; reservations-only policy should be prominently noted so touring cyclists plan ahead.
enrichment_extras.notes: Firewood is available for purchase on-site. The same operator runs Purden Ski Village (winter only); the ski hill subpage showed a closed notice, but that is the separate winter operation — the lake resort is the relevant summer/camping operation.

wow_evidence: coin-op hot showers and coin-op laundry … sandy beach, lake swimming
